source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Predicates and Variables with the comparison (Ali is Tall), a self-check and a small program of ours (PDF 31, printed 27).

blocks.text: Predicates cheezon ki properties ya rishte bayan karte hain. Maslan “isEven(x)” tab sach hai jab x even (juft) number ho. Variables domain of discourse (jin cheezon ki baat ho rahi hai un ka group) ki cheezon ya values ko dikhate hain. Variables se hum aam statements likh sakte hain, jaise “For all x, x > 0” (har x ke liye, x zero se bara hai). Predicates aur variables mil kar predicate logic ke expressions banate hain, jo mushkil khayalat saaf aur formal tareeqe se bayan karte hain. Reasoning aur problem solving ke liye inhein samajhna zaroori hai.

items: A ke andar nahi dekh sakte: pata nahi chalta ke baat kis ke baare mein hai aur kya kaha gaya hai.
Subject (jis ki baat ho rahi hai) Ali aur property Tall dono nazar aate hain.
Kahin zyada expressive (zyada baat bata sakti hai).

blocks.prompt: “Sara student hai” aur “Sara ko cricket pasand hai” predicates se likhein. Propositional logic kyun nahi dikha sakti ke dono baatein Sara ke baare mein hain?
blocks.explanation: Student(Sara) aur Likes(Sara, cricket). Propositional logic mein yeh P aur Q jaise do alag letters ban jate hain jo subject ko chhupa dete hain, is liye pata nahi chalta ke dono Sara ke baare mein hain aur us par reasoning nahi ho sakti.

blocks.text: Python mein predicate ek aisa function hai jo True ya False lauta deta hai. Neeche isEven(x) aur “x > 5” dono predicates hain; x badal kar dekhein.

x = 7   # variable ki value badal kar dekhein

def isEven(x):
    return x % 2 == 0

def greater_than_5(x):
    return x > 5

print("x =", x)
print("isEven(x):", isEven(x))
print("x > 5:", greater_than_5(x))

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"x = 7": variable x ki value.
"def isEven(x): return x % 2 == 0": predicate isEven. % baqi (remainder) deta hai; 2 se taqseem (divide) par baqi 0 ho to number even hai aur True lautta hai.
"def greater_than_5(x): return x > 5": doosra predicate, kitab ki misal “x is greater than 5”.
Teeno print lines x ki value aur dono predicates ka nateeja dikhati hain.
Output: "x = 7", "isEven(x): False" aur "x > 5: True".
Khud try karein: x = 4 kar ke Run karein: "isEven(x): True" aur "x > 5: False" aayega. Yani predicate ka sach ya jhoot hona variable ki value par depend karta hai.

items: Predicate: property ya rishta, jaise isEven(x) ya Tall(Ali).
Variable domain of discourse ki cheezon ko dikhata hai.
A = "Ali is Tall" andar se band hai; Tall(Ali) subject aur property dono dikhata hai.
